<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.41.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Add pathlib support by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9711
* Follow ups for pathlib support by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9783
* Support primary color as text and background color in markdown by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9676
* Improve hover tooltips for `st.line_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9674
* Add support for ISO time/date format in st.time_input / st.date_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9753
* Add async generator support to `st.write_stream` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8724
* Add _repr_html_ support to st.html, and avoid throwing for non-paths by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9877
* Remove temporary padding fix for fullscreen button by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9882
* Allow pinning dataframe columns via column config by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9535
* Remove internal Streamlit details from exception traces  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9913
* Borderless `"tertiary"` buttons by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9923
* Improvements to the showErrorDetails config by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9909
* Border for `st.metric` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9928
* Border for `st.columns` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9927
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Disallow double slash paths to redirect by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9754
* Fix usage of hyphens in user key for CSS classes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9793
* Fix #9763. Don't show text keyboard for number input on IOS by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9766
* Fixes a bug where timezones with a non- x:00 utc offset would start at a non 00:00 timer for st.audio_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9791
* Fix dataframe fullscreen for large dataframes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9803
* fix #9810 Update to latest Material symbols font by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9813
* Fix exception element styling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9818
* [Fix] Prevent rerun for text_input when value did not change by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9826
* [Fix] Set text area value based on state by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9829
* Correctly handle `DeltaGenerator` in `st.write` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9828
* Add shared hooks for submitForm & inputChange by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9847
* Set the default selection mode to 'single' in the overload methods of pills and segmented_control by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9801
* [fix] st.graphviz_chart rendering bug with use_container_width=True by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9867
* Support URLPattern-compatible patterns in allowed domain matching by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9849
* Fix wrong dataframe return typing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9898
* Fix URI decoding of link column display text by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9895
* Disallow invalid scopes for st.rerun by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9911
* Fix slow rendering performance caused by complex CSS selector by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9901
* Update audio buffer to handle channels better by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9885
* Only show st.cache decorator spinners for cache misses and outermost function by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9956
* Have Images List not utilize the individual image width parameter by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9958
### Other Changes
* Clean up hello app by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9760
* Adds a timestamp into the file name for st.audio_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9768
* Update watchdog to include 6.x.x  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9785
* release/1.40.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9790
* Release/1.40.1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9831
* Release/1.40.2 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9925
* Set Python 3.13 as max version for Streamlit by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9635

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9849
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9931

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.40.2...1.41.0
